content.overview: Article 29 protects minority language/script/culture interests and bars denial of admission on listed grounds. Article 30 gives religious and linguistic minorities the right to establish and administer educational institutions.
content.study: Minority is typically State-wise for Article 30. Reasonable regulation of standards is permitted; annihilation of minority character is not.
